definitions.short: Tsiklag or Tsikelag , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H6860. Tsiqelag ִצקְלַג and ( 1Chr 12:1 ; 12:21 ׳צִיק ) proper name, of a location ( צִ֒קלָ֑ג 1Sam 27:6 a +, ִצקְלָג֖ 2Sam 2:1 צִיקְלָ֔ג 1Chr 12:1 ); — assigned to Judah Josh 15:31 , to Simeon 19:5 ; Philistine city given to David 1Sam 27:6 (twice in verse); 30:1 (3 t. in verse); 30:14 , 26 ; 2Sam 1:1 ; 4:10 ; 1Chr 4:30 ; 12:1 ; 12:21 (van d. H. v. 12:20 ); Σεκελακ , Σικελαγ , etc.; usually identified with Zuheilikah , 19 miles southwest from Bêt Jibrin, 11 miles east-southeast from Gaza (compare Buhl Geogr. 185 ).
definitions.rootNote: or צִיקלַג ; (1 Chronicles 12:1,20), of uncertain derivation;
